crossRefs.note: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone. Don’t encroach on the fields of the fatherless,
for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you.
The people of the land have used oppression and exercised robbery. Yes, they have troubled the poor and needy, and have…
Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich, both come to poverty.
“You shall not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.
Because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,
“If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,
if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate,
Don’t oppress the widow, nor the fatherless, the foreigner, nor the poor; and let none of you devise evil against his…
I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers…

translations.web: Don’t exploit the poor, because he is poor; and don’t crush the needy in court;
translations.bsb: Do not rob a poor man because he is poor, and do not crush the afflicted at the gate,
translations.kjv: Rob not the poor, because he is poor: neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:
translations.asv: Rob not the poor, because he is poor; Neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:
